liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dancing In The Streets (instrumental #1)** (1 other source): Instrumental take of the newly reworked Dancing In The Streets, following two false starts [1]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-08-26.140933.studio.bershaw.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 4 songs; 11 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes Garcia played Travis Bean guitars (TB1000 and TB500) in 1976, so likely a Travis Bean through the Mu-Tron III [2]
- Studio session, not a concert: instrumental attempts at the recently revamped arrangement of Dancing In The Streets, including two false starts [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-08-26.140933.studio.bershaw.flac1644**: source: source/lineage: studio reel -> ? -> Maxell MX-S 100 cassette with Dolby B; [1]. Also: Reviewer says this is the earliest recording found of Jerry Garcia using a Mu-Tron III envelope filter from Musitronics [2]
